questions.q: The multimeter shows 16.42 V, INAV — 15.95 V with vbat_scale = 1100. What is the new value?
questions.explain: The voltage in INAV is directly proportional to vbat_scale: new = 1100 × 16.42 / 15.95 ≈ 1132. You get 1069 if you invert the ratio.

questions.q: INAV counted 1120 mAh, the charger put back 1030 mAh, current_meter_scale = 400. What do you set?
questions.explain: I = (U − offset) / scale: the reading is inversely proportional to scale, so new = 400 × 1120 / 1030 ≈ 435 (the formula from docs/Battery.md).

questions.q: After `set motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT300` and `save` in SITL, `get` shows MULTISHOT. Why?
options: SITL is built without USE_DSHOT, config.c replaces the protocol
DSHOT300 was removed from INAV 9, only DSHOT600 is left
`feature DSHOT` was not run, and without it the protocol is reset
The protocol is changed only on the Outputs tab, the CLI does not write it
questions.explain: In fc/config.c: #if !defined(USE_DSHOT) — a protocol above BRUSHED is replaced with MULTISHOT. The protocol and the motors are checked only on a real board.

questions.q: A script sends channels to SITL in AETR order (throttle = 1000), but MSP_RC shows throttle 1500 and pitch 1000. What is the error?
questions.fragment:
# map
Map: TAER
MSP_RC ch1-8: (1500, 1000, 1500, 1500, 1000, 1000, 1500, 1500)
# MSP_RC order: roll, pitch, yaw, throttle
options: rxrange 1 and 3 are swapped
The channel map is TAER instead of AETR
Pitch reverse is enabled on the radio
receiver_type = MSP instead of SERIAL
questions.explain: With map TAER the first channel (roll 1500) is read as throttle, the third (throttle 1000) — as pitch. CRSF needs the AETR map (default).

questions.q: In INAV Quad X the rule `mmix 0 1.000 -1.000 1.000 -1.000` — which motor is it?
options: Front left, CW rotation
Front right, CCW rotation
Rear left, CCW rotation
Rear right, CW rotation
questions.explain: Roll −1 — the right side, pitch +1 — a rear motor (it speeds up when the nose goes down), yaw −1 — it slows down on a “clockwise” command, so it spins clockwise itself.

questions.q: failsafe_procedure = RTH, but when the radio was turned off at 80 m the aircraft immediately started landing on the spot. The most likely cause?
options: There was no GPS fix or compass at the moment it triggered
failsafe_delay = 5 is too short for RTH
nav_rth_altitude is lower than the current flight altitude
failsafe_stick_threshold = 50 blocks RTH
questions.explain: Multirotor RTH requires GPS, a compass and a baro; if a sensor is missing, INAV performs an emergency landing immediately (docs/Failsafe.md).

questions.q: INAV shows an idle current of 0.69 A, the ammeter — 0.45 A, current_meter_scale = 435, offset = 0. The new current_meter_offset?
questions.explain: The offset is subtracted from the sensor voltage and removes offset/scale amps: new = 0 + (0.69 − 0.45) × 435 ≈ 104.

questions.q: Which of these cannot be checked in INAV SITL without an external simulator?
options: The channel map over MSP RX
The RX flag when RC is lost
RTH from 100 m with a landing at home
Restoring the config from diff all
questions.explain: Without RealFlight/X-Plane SITL runs in Configurator only mode: there is no physics, and the aircraft does not arm (CAL NAV ACC). The config, channels and flags can be checked, flight cannot.
